name: Refugee Status / Subsidiary Protection

qualifying_event.description: The State Agency for Refugees (SAR) examines all applications for international protection made in Bulgaria. Applicants must declare intent to seek protection immediately to Border Police or National Police, or apply directly at SAR or from immigration detention.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Registration with SAR; fingerprinting; medical screening; RSD interview.

requirements.blocker_text: SAR determines eligibility for full refugee status or the lesser subsidiary/humanitarian protection status, via registration, interview, and assessment. General procedure decisions arrive within 6 months; accelerated procedure within 14 working days; complex cases up to 21 months.
Applicant must attend the RSD interview and provide detailed, consistent reasons for leaving their country with supporting documentation; missing the appointment risks termination of the procedure.

outcome.duration_length: Refugee status: 5-year residence document; Subsidiary/humanitarian protection: 3-year residence document. Both statuses themselves are granted indefinitely; only the identity document requires periodic renewal.

sources.title: UNHCR Bulgaria -- Applying for Asylum in Bulgaria: State Agency for Refugees process, registration, interview, decision timelines (6 months standard / 14 days accelerated / up to 21 months complex cases), appeal windows
